subject: Editor freezes after Search and Replace

messages.author: e5eeb0c47fdbba84
messages.subject: Editor freezes after Search and Replace
parts:
Dear all,

I use JGR (v. 1.7-5)/ Deducer on Linux Ubuntu 11.04. My R version is
2.13.0 (2011-04-13).

The editor freezes reproducible, when I use the Find -> Replace ->
Replace All command to search and replace text in my command/syntax
file.

Please apologize if this is the wrong group.

If you tell me how, I will be happy to supply more detailed
information. I could not find any error message in /var/log/syslog. I
have to use the kill command to close JGR/R.

As I can use another editor this is not a high priority problem.

Thank you for your help.

Sincerely

Karl-Heinz

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Editor freezes after Search and Replace
parts:
Karl,

I'm moving this over to a more appropriate list. I am unable to
reproduce the issue generally on Mac OS X, but I played around a
little and did notice an infinite loop if you tried to replace a
string by a string that contained the string to be replaced. For
example "some" by "something."


Ian
